definitions.implemented: A tested reusable prototype depicts this original concept. This does not mean every adjacency, variant, animation or final-quality requirement is complete.
definitions.partial: A related renderable treatment or component exists, but the original translated concept is incomplete.
definitions.not built: The original translated concept has no current implementation. Unrelated legacy artwork does not count.

evidence_notes: Statuses describe reusable concept prototypes reviewed through55, not final visual quality or all neighbor/climate combinations.
All 91 non-mushroom runtime PNGs from48 are unchanged. Four historical mushroom PNGs were replaced by five real-jungle54 PNGs; the current runtime has130 canonical PNGs.
All90 unknown base cells and all27 input JSON files in the nine observed layouts remain unchanged. Actual Civ4 late-strategic and precious resource source cells remain unverified.
Authored river topology is explicit shared-edge design. qa/authored_river_migration55.json retains the previous paths for eight migrated layouts; observed traces remain diagnostic evidence.

The compact core includes one complete default Tiled sample and all25 independently renderable inputs. Extra cached exports and frozen artwork-source packs are optional; source screenshots are excluded.
Tiled validation covers JSON/XML, relative references, semantics and exact visible-pixel reconstruction. Native Tiled GUI and downstream-engine testing have not been performed.
Historical versioned integration and QA documents retain their named checkpoint scope and do not override the current55 inventory.
